located_observations.observation: Close dark bodies continue to frame a distant room; adults viewing pictures and adults conversing remain joined above the open sunlit floor. Lower title is the first textual anchor.

located_observations.location: lower identity and high wall groups
located_observations.observation: Central subtitle/title/English leads to the upper-left four-line visit schedule and upper-right two-line conditions. Welcome remains beside the left near-body crop, no information footer.
Welcome/visit lines are larger than initial, with clear glyph blocks and word spaces, and I can read both supplied sentences. Their scale remains smaller than the 16–16.5px plan.

located_observations.location: foreground clothes, adult bodies, plants, floor and wall
located_observations.observation: Hair and clothing now use controlled planar shades, faces and plants are drawn; lens softness has been removed. Interior uses opaque painted planes with selective outlines. Wall architecture photographs remain content of the exhibition.
Title is thinner than initial with open counters and distinct word gaps. Subtitle is also less heavy. English tracking remains broad.
Time uses visible colons and a horizontal range dash; dates, middle dots, Korean word boundaries and all eleven entries read as transcribed. No extra print, logo, QR or watermark appears.

located_observations.location: far adults and seated conversation right
located_observations.observation: Standing feet meet the shared floor and seated adult legs meet seats/floor. Hands are simplified small forms but conversational positions remain understandable; no required functional grip is involved.

The room, body crops and perspective organize the whole frame; wall photos are part of a substantive exhibition scene rather than separate subordinate poster insets. Information lies in quiet surfaces of that same space.

substantive_non_glyph.observation: Shared adult room, photographs, viewing/conversation, depth-defining body crops and sunlit floor contribute to event content and whole composition.

style.observation: Modern painted/drawn adult panorama now implemented through opaque planes and selected contours. Close crop and far wall relationships retained; no identifiable real building or institution.

hangul.observation: Open title counters and natural square syllable proportions remain readable. Word gaps and Korean small-text syllables were distinguishable at usage720; normal/medium title weight replaces initial very heavy type.

information_relationship.observation: Both experiences occupy the same room. Floor subtitle names both; practical visit groups are separated high left/right, with nearby welcome. All information located without interpreting pseudo-signage.

function_contact.observation: No required gripping/support function or contact-copy request. Simplified conversational hand outlines are visible.

material_edge_finish.observation: Crisp opaque clothing and consistent boundaries replace lens blur; far photo images retain photographic architectural content. Adult floor/seat contacts are coherent within the drawing.

template_exclusion.observation: Close bodies, distant wall and open floor create the full frame. Typography uses that distance; no passive title/date block field with subordinate inset/bottom strip imagery.

residuals.location: left welcome/visit and high-wall information at usage720
residuals.limit: Welcome text remains visually smaller than the original 16–16.5px plan; practical groups require deliberate reading after the central identity, though all entries were readable in this view.
Observed dash/middle-dot shapes remain legible; original Unicode code points cannot be certified from raster shapes.
Floor retains smooth reflective shading and small hands use simplified contours rather than detailed anatomy.

decision.reason: Compared with initial, this implements painting/drawing, lighter type and larger welcome while keeping the substantive shared-space concept and all copy. No additional observed mandatory defect calls for another repair; plan-size differences alone do not justify a call.
